test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One thing that can be divided
solution:
The correct answer is: **Divisible.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Divisible** means capable of being evenly divided, without remainder.

 
 
• **Example -** *The math teacher explained that the number 10 is **divisible** by 2, but cannot be split by three equally.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the** 'Divisible'** can be used as a one-word substitute for **'One thing that can be divided.'**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Remainder** means the part that is left after the other parts are gone, used, or taken away.
 
• **Quotient** means a result obtained by dividing one quantity by another.
 
• **Dividend** means the value that is divided by another value to get the result.
